skill_name: State the main arguments that the abstract makes
workflow: The main argument of this paper is that discretizing continuous prompts for natural language processing tasks has its drawbacks, as evidenced by "wayward" behavior that can be observed. Such behavior is especially prevalent when larger model sizes are used. This in turn has important implications for faithfully interpreting continuous prompts and generalizing them across models and tasks, and necessitates potential changes to the approach used.
